parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The maps below show the site of a school in 2013 and the planned one in 2016. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: Some people think that by paying taxes they have contributed enough to their society. Others think there are other responsibilities besides paying taxes. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
